authorizes: nothing; this config has no runtime, no venue access, and no REAL_MONEY implication
claim: The crowded-short funding premium captured MARKET-NEUTRALLY: long the perp on the venue where funding is more negative, short the same symbol's perp on the other venue; the price legs cancel to basis noise and the P&L identity keeps the funding DIFFERENTIAL. Per-name hysteresis on the trailing 24h settled spread (bybit minus binance): enter |spread| > 80 bp/day, hold while > 20 bp/day and the direction is unchanged; flat 0.10 per name (one-side notional), gross cap 1.0; BOTH legs' taker fees charged (15.56 bp per unit one-way). Corrected module path, 2021-01..2026-07-27: 5.1 bp/day, t 2.92, Sharpe 1.34, max DD -16.7%, one-way 0.087/day; bench window Sharpe 1.61. Unlike the directional book it is OFFSET-STABLE (decision-clock sweep, review-script frame: 1.10-1.28 full / 1.36-1.61 bench) and nearly uncorrelated with carry_hold_v3 (rho +0.09).
portfolio_note: Registered as the second leg of the funding-carry program. A PIT 60d rolling vol-parity combination with lane2_carry_hold_v3 (mean weights ~20/80 dir/neutral) measures, on seen data: bench-window Sharpe 2.34 / max DD -11.2% / MAR 5.07 at the standard clock, and 1.93-2.34 across the 4-offset sweep; full-window (2021-inclusive) 1.55-1.87. The owner's Sharpe >= 2 target is met on the program's standard quote basis (the bench window every published comparison uses) robustly across clocks, and NOT met on the strictest basis (full window, worst clock). Both numbers are the claim; neither is hidden. The portfolio itself is a documented construction over the two registered configs - the ledger scores both daily and the combination is reconstructable forward.

universe.note: 168h maturity on BOTH venues; both trailing fundings, both forward funding sums, and both forward returns must be finite

spread.signal: trailing 24h settled funding, bybit minus binance, each venue's own settlement-exact detector
spread.note: direction = long the more-negative-funding venue; a direction flip forces an exit before re-entry. Grid at selection: enter {30,50,80} x exit {10,20}, Sharpe 1.05-1.34, monotone toward deeper entries (fees eat small spreads); 80/20 chosen at the plateau edge with by far the lowest turnover. Depth-proportional sizing was tested and REJECTED (deeper spread carries more basis vol; Sharpe falls).

sizing.note: cap and gross are ONE-SIDE notional; the account must margin both legs (roughly 2x the margin per unit vs a directional book) - a feasibility note for any future sizing decision, not modelled here

risk.note: recipe comparability only; raw is primary

cost_model.charging: measured one-way turnover x fee per side x TWO legs, per day
cost_model.funding: settlement_exact on BOTH venues (2026-07-28 corrected detector)
not_modelled: margin cost of the second venue

scoring_recipe.metric: mean net bp per day and annualised Sharpe on the raw daily series
scoring_recipe.comparator: zero, lane2_carry_hold_v3 (the portfolio partner), and the deployed CONTINUOUS render
scoring_recipe.cadence: one row per completed UTC day after the registration commit (scripts/score_financed_longs_forward.py)
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only days strictly after the registration commit date count as forward evidence

measured_at_registration.basis: CORRECTED settlement-exact scorer, module path, panel 2021-01-01..2026-07-28 (seen data; Lane-1 selection, not evidence)
measured_at_registration.offset_sweep: decision clocks {0,6,12,18}h (review-script frame): full 1.28/1.10/1.15/1.23, bench 1.61/1.36/1.38/1.51 - offset-stable, unlike the directional family
measured_at_registration.conditional_diagnostic: per-name-day Sharpe by |spread| bucket: 80-150 bp/day -> 2.08, >150 -> 1.91; the premium is real and deep spreads carry it
measured_at_registration.basis_risk_measured: the cross-venue price difference has 40 bp/day sd normally but 677 bp/day when |spread| > 50 - the 'neutral' book is NOT riskless exactly when it is active; this is the honest reason its standalone Sharpe is 1.3 and not 3
measured_at_registration.multiple_testing: wave 3 ran ~15 cells (6 declared grid + 3 sizing + 4 offsets + combos), all reported in docs/research_2026-07-28_carry_hold_quant_review.md s10; new mechanism, t 2.9, graded by its forward run
measured_at_registration.provenance: Selected 2026-07-28 by wave 3 of the carry-hold quant review on seen data; the mechanism was checked against both negative ledgers first (prior cross-venue items were price-premium signals and the directional Binance replication - neither is this trade).

known_weaknesses: 2023-24 eras are ~zero to slightly negative (-0.1/-3.1 bp/day): the spread barely existed before the funding-inversion era; if funding normalizes the book goes dormant and pays fees on marginal signals
basis risk concentrates exactly in active states (677 bp/day sd when wide); a venue outage or liquidation desync during a squeeze is the tail
leg execution asynchrony is not modelled: entering two venues' takers at the same close is optimistic by up to seconds-to-minutes of drift
the daily frame's terminal-day look-ahead caveat applies (shared with every financed-longs number)
capacity inherits the deep-funding-name constraint (~$1M at 1% participation on the Bybit leg) and both venues must list the name
margin on two venues halves capital efficiency vs a directional book at the same notional
